title: Associate Product Operations Manager Campinas, Brazil
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for an Associate Product Operations Manager to help evolve the way retailers operate within BEES. The Product Operations Team serves as a strategic partner to the Product organization, enabling efficiency, alignment, and operational excellence through well-designed processes, rituals, and data-driven insights.

Our mission is to support a winning product strategy and ensure best-in‑class digital product delivery that drives BEES’ commercial objectives. We do this by managing the product roadmap, building scalable processes, and strengthening cross‑functional collaboration across global teams and product areas.

This role sits within the Strategy & Operations group at BEES and will work closely with Product, Program, Engineering, and Commercial stakeholders across our worldwide ecosystem.

What you’ll do

  • Support the quarterly intake, prioritization, and roadmapping processes end‑to‑end, ensuring organizational alignment.
  • Manage and update roadmap changes throughout the quarter, maintaining communication with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Prepare materials, consolidate inputs, and support structured discussions for weekly problem‑statement reviews with Product & Engineering leadership.
  • Act as a support partner to Product Managers, ensuring initiatives, documentation, and JIRA items are complete and ready for strategic decision‑making.
  • Work closely with Commercial teams to operationalize business cases, validate commercial inputs, and ensure high‑quality information reaches Product for prioritization.
  • Support and prepare productization meetings with directors, ensuring clarity, consistent materials, and operational readiness.
  • Transform hypotheses into structured initiatives and facilitate alignment loops with senior leadership.
  • Maintain and evolve documentation in Confluence, ensuring accuracy and accessibility.
  • Build dashboards and reports to support leadership insights and product decision‑making.
  • Support change‑management initiatives and contribute to improving operational processes across the ecosystem.

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Strategy, Project Management, or related fields.
  • Experience with project management, structured planning, and process organization.
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication skills, including preparing presentations and engaging with senior stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage diverse inputs and moving parts.
  • Interest in product strategy and understanding how commercial inputs connect to product decisions.
  • Ability to operate in a dynamic, non‑linear business environment with frequent changes.
  • Experience supporting operational rituals, documentation, and cross‑functional alignment (plus).
  • Tools: MS Office, JIRA, Confluence, Lucid tools, PowerBI.
  • Languages: Fluent English; Conversational Spanish is a plus.

What Makes This Role Challenging (and Exciting)

  • The BEES ecosystem is highly dynamic.
  • The scope is new within the team, offering autonomy, but also requiring comfort with ambiguity as processes mature.
  • You will interact with a wide range of product areas, understanding their quarterly plans and ensuring smooth operational alignment.
  • You will play a key role in ensuring that strategy reaches execution teams with clarity and structure.

What We Offer

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

Equal Opportunity & Affinitary Action

AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affinitary Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

description:
Job description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Buscamos um(a) Advogado(a) Júnior para integrar o time jurídico corporativo, com atuação voltada às áreas de societário, contratos financeiros e imobiliário. O(a) profissional será responsável por apoiar na elaboração, revisão e acompanhamento de documentos societários e contratuais, bem como no suporte jurídico às operações e projetos estratégicos da companhia.

Procuramos um(a) Analista de Mercado/ BI PL para atuar no monitoramento e análise do mercado de couro bovino.

A posição integra a área de Business Intelligence da companhia que é responsável pelas demandas de inteligência de mercado e, portanto, pela geração de análises e insights que orientam as decisões comerciais e estratégicas dos negócios.

Main responsibilities

Principais atividades:

  • Acompanhar preços, fluxos de exportação e importação, volumes e players do mercado, bem como dos mercados que utilizam couro bovino como matéria-prima;
  • Fazer projeções de preços;
  • Monitorar indicadores econômicos e geopolíticos que impactam o negócio;
  • Pesquisar, tratar, estruturar e analisar bases de dados, tanto internos quanto de fontes externas (tais como consultorias de dados, sites oficiais dos países, associações representativas de setores etc.), utilizando Excel, Power BI, SQL e Python;
  • Mapear tendências e dados do mercado, contextualizá-los e apresentá-los em PowerPoint nas reuniões com o time comercial;
  • Conduzir as reuniões semanais com o time comercial para discussão sobre mercado, preços, volume e posicionamento de mercado;
  • Criar relatórios e dashboards para apoio às decisões comerciais.

Requirements and skills

Formação em Administração, Economia, Comércio Exterior, Engenharia(s) ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência (mesmo que breve) em análises de mercado e atividades de inteligência

Domínio de Excel avançado e conhecimento em SQL e Python.

Desejável: Power BI e inglês intermediário/avançado.

Additional information

Local: Campinas/SP - Presencial

Área: Inteligência de Mercado / BI

Tipo de contrato: CLT

UX Designer - Dados - Híbrido em Campinas

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenhar a experiência e arquitetura visual de dashboards executivos , com foco em métricas / indicadores de performance digital .

O objetivo é transformar dados quantitativos complexos em interfaces executivas claras, consistentes e orientadas à tomada de decisão .

A atuação será em interface direta com analistas de dados e cientistas de mídia , exigindo alta capacidade de abstração, síntese e pensamento sistêmico aplicado à visualização de informações.

Principais responsabilidades:

Mapeamento de necessidades executivas : entender os indicadores-chave de negócio (KPI e OKR) e traduzi-los em fluxos e layouts de visualização.

Arquitetura de informação aplicada a dados : organizar painéis complexos em camadas de contexto, relevância e storytelling visual.

Design de dashboards em Figma : criação de sistemas visuais escaláveis, uso avançado de auto-layout, componentes e tokens de design.

Modelagem de hierarquia e densidade informacional : priorizar leitura, escaneabilidade e clareza executiva em painéis de alto nível.

Interlocução com times de dados : validação de métricas, naming conventions, KPIs e estrutura lógica de agrupamentos.

Documentação técnica : padronizar o sistema visual e garantir rastreabilidade e consistência entre dashboards e apresentações executivas.

Storytelling de dados : estruturar narrativas visuais que permitam interpretação rápida e contextualização estratégica, boas práticas de visualização de dados também.

Requisitos técnicos:

Experiência comprovada em UX Design voltado a Data Visualization / Dashboards / BI Interfaces .

Domínio avançado de Figma (componentização, grid systems, prototipação e documentação).

Inglês fluente para lidar com documentação técnica e stakeholders internacionais.

Familiaridade com métricas de mídia, social e performance digital (alcance, engajamento, CPM, CTR, share of voice, sentiment, etc.).

Conhecimento em design de informação , usabilidade aplicada a dados e storytelling analítico.

Capacidade analítica para ler e estruturar dados numéricos com coerência visual e semântica.

Diferenciais

Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau ou similares).

Vivência com data storytelling , service design ou inteligência de negócios .

Experiência anterior em contextos corporativos complexos , com múltiplos stakeholders executivos.

É importante que o profissional tenha:

Raciocínio lógico e sensibilidade visual, capaz de conectar usabilidade, dados e narrativa executiva. Autonomia técnica, comunicação assertiva em inglês e domínio de ferramentas de design e dados.

Contratação em modelo PJ com benefícios.

Atuação direta com times globais, proporcionando trocas riquíssimas.

Ambiente acelerado com muitas oportunidades de crescimento.

Só um pouquinho de dados. Ou um montão deles.

A quantidade não é o mais importante, mas sim o uso que fazemos das informações. Na Just a Little Data, nosso papel é exatamente este: ajudar empresas - sejam elas multinacionais ou negócios locais - a potencializar o conhecimento por trás dos dados.

Para isso, contamos não só com um time feito de especialistas em business, tecnologia, comunicação e outras áreas, mas com toda a estrutura e apoio do grupo B&Partners , do qual fazemos parte.

Queremos revolucionar o processo de tomada de decisão nas empresas e tornar a ciência de dados mais acessível, para que ela seja uma vantagem competitiva de negócios de diversos segmentos.

Nosso clima é de startup, com desafios, projetos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento constantes. Valorizamos a criatividade, unicidade de bagagem, bem estar e autonomia das pessoas que atuam conosco. Afinal, são elas que fazem a empresa, e não o contrário. Se curtiu a ideia de somar com a gente, veja nossas vagas em aberto - uma delas pode ser a sua cara. E o seu perfil, a nossa.

Missão

Solucionar problemas e direcionar operações com tecnologia e ciência de dados da maneira mais prática e objetiva visando aumentar os resultados dos nossos clientes e parceiros.

Inquietude: tudo sempre pode melhorar;

Conhecimento profundo do que faz;

Comprometimento e transparência nas relações (B2B e B2C);

Assertividade e precisão na entrega.

Diversidade

Aqui na Just, respeitar as identidades e valores de cada indivíduo não é só uma questão fundamental, mas obrigatória. Acreditamos que contar com pessoas de todos os tipos no nosso time é exatamente o que precisamos para nos desenvolver em todos os sentidos. Por isso, diferentes visões, bagagens e modos de ser são e serão sempre bem-vindos na nossa casa.

Como parte do grupo , somos signatário do Pacto Global da ONU , e lideramos dois importantes movimentos: Elas Lideram 2030 e Raça é Prioridade . Isso se traduz em metas claras: 50% de lideranças femininas e 50% de pessoas negras em posições de liderança , reforçando nosso compromisso com equidade real e contínua.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia com um equilíbrio que nos orgulha!

Aqui, mulheres são maioria , provando que inovação e diversidade caminham juntas.

Bora somar e deixar os gráficos abaixo cada vez menos padronizados!

Nossa forma de trabalhar é híbrida, mais para remota.

Na Just, valorizamos o equilíbrio entre autonomia e alinhamento. Por isso, temos vagas remotas, híbridas e algumas que pedem presença em São Paulo , seja para encontros no escritório ou momentos conforme o escopo da vaga exigir. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Enfermeiro(a) Oncológico / Centro de Oncologia Vera Cruz
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • A Enfermeira Navegadora Oncológica será responsável por
  • Realizar o acolhimento integral do paciente em todas as etapas do tratamento, estabelecendo uma relação de confiança e oferecendo suporte contínuo;
  • Atuar como elo entre os setores hospitalares e a clínica de oncologia, garantindo comunicação eficiente, organização dos fluxos e a integração das informações assistenciais.
  • Acompanhar diário do paciente internado;
  • Monitorar suas necessidades;
  • Orientar sobre procedimentos e etapas do tratamento, além do auxílio em processos administrativos;
  • Agendamentos, encaminhamentos e suporte às demandas da equipe multiprofissional.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar treinamentos específicos na área de oncologia, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe e para a padronização de práticas seguras.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Possuir Graduação completa em Enfermagem;
  • Pós Graduação em Oncologia;
  • Possuir Coren ativo;
  • Experiência em setor Oncológico ou Clínica de Oncologia;
  • Conhecimentos sobre protocolos assistenciais e fluxos hospitalares.
  • Disponibilidade de horário 9:48 às 18:00 seg à sex.
  • Domínio de ferramentas administrativas e assistenciais, incluindo sistemas de prontuário eletrônico, planilhas e registros digitais que apoiem o acompanhamento do paciente.

Informações adicionais

  • Residir em Campinas, Sumaré, Hortolândia, Paulínia, Valinhos ou Monte Mor.
  • Plano de Saúde - 2Care Vera Cruz, extensivo a dependentes (coparticipativo e com desconto aos dependentes);
  • Plano Odontológico - Amil Dental, extensivo a dependentes (com desconto);
  • Vale Alimentação (cartão);
  • Vale Refeição com desconto para colaboradores com jornada acima de 6 horas diária;
  • VT com desconto de 6% caso seja solicitado;
  • Auxílio Creche para mulheres (crianças até 4 anos e 11 meses de idade);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Wellhub (Gympass), extensivo a dependentes;
  • Parceria SESC, extensivo a dependentes;
  • Participação nos Resultados conforme política e resultados atingidos;
  • Bolsa Auxílio para cursos conforme política.

title: Operador(a) de Caixa
description:
Porque Trabalhar Conosco

O Grupo Savegnago oferece um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, oportunidades de crescimento profissional e uma equipe acolhedora que valoriza a colaboração e a inovação.

Sobre a Vaga

O Operador(a) de Caixa desempenha um papel crucial na experiência do cliente e na eficiência financeira da empresa. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem registrar compras, calcular valores, receber pagamentos em dinheiro, cartões ou outros meios, emitir recibos e fornecer troco, se necessário. São encarregados também de manter a precisão nas transações, resolver problemas de pagamento e garantir um excelente atendimento ao cliente.

O Que Você Irá Entregar

  • Registrar (scanear) corretamente as mercadorias e observar os produtos a fim de evitar registrar a mesma marca com variações diferentes;
  • Receber valores de acordo com a forma de pagamento dentro dos procedimentos validados pela empresa, conferir e efetuar troco, quando necessário;
  • Emitir e entregar cupom fiscal ao cliente;
  • Confirmar e informar o valor e as condições de pagamento ao cliente;
  • Auxiliar no empacotamento dos produtos quando necessário;
  • Solicitar a apresentação de documento de identificação do cliente, de acordo com a forma de pagamento (normas e procedimentos da empresa);
  • Informar, orientar e direcionar o cliente quando o mesmo solicitar informações;
  • Divulgar promoções e descontos;
  • Efetuar fechamento do movimento do caixa junto a tesouraria;
  • Manusear as mercadorias com cuidado evitando quebras/perdas;
  • Observar com atenção os carrinhos de compra se todos os produtos foram registrados;
  • Observar movimentação de clientes principalmente no momento de fechamento e/ ou recolhimento monetário dos caixas;
  • Entender o funcionamento dos demais setores da empresa podendo orientar aos clientes quando questionado;
  • Conferir cheques recebidos, verificar autenticidade das cédulas recebidas, organizando em gaveta apropriada;
  • Informar tesoureira/fiscal de caixa a necessidade de sangria de valores quando atingir valor pré-estabelecido pela empresa;
  • Verificar condições de limpeza e abastecimento dos artigos expostos no check-out;
  • Participar do inventário, quando convocado;
  • Executar corretamente o procedimento de entrega anotando com atenção os dados referentes ao endereço, numeração de caixas e lacres.

Estamos Em Busca De Pessoas Que Possuam

  • Ensino médio completo.

title: KYC Analyst
description:
Marex Group plc is a diversified global financial services platform, providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients in the energy, commodities and financial markets. It listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market in April 2024. With more than 35 offices in Europe, US and APAC, it has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology‑led service provides access to all major exchanges, order‑flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award‑winning data, insights and analytics.

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combatting financial crime and terrorist financing.

Role Summary

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that appropriate CDD / KYC and AML checks are carried out on all new customers in accordance with local regulatory requirements and Group standards and procedures
  • Ensure that appropriate client documentation is issued to all new customers and in accordance with local regulatory and any exchange requirements
  • Ensure that appropriate customer categorisations are carried out in accordance with local regulatory requirements
  • Ensure daily targets set by the Onboarding Manager are met
  • Accurately update the customer pipeline on a daily basis (Neon Onboarding)
  • Ensure that client and static data is accurately input and maintained into the Client Data Base (PeopleSoft)
  • Ensure that complete records of all customer documentation are maintained
  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑Ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews/projects/audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out
  • Efficiently dealing with general day‑to‑day ad‑hoc queries
  • Work closely with the Financial Crime team
  • Keeping management timely informed of issues/developments
  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with Marex’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To elevate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills and Experience

  • Experience in client onboarding, KYC and risk assessment of clients
  • Solid understanding of client categorisation
  • Worked in support of trading desks
  • Analytical skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.
  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self‑efficient and influences a positive work environment
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast‑paced environment
  • Ability to work within a fast paced and high‑volume environment
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing othersStrategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

Conduct Rules

You must:

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect

Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity

Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative

We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People

Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble

Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non‑bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

title: Arquiteto de Engenharia de Software
description:
Overview

Fazemos parte do Grupo BTG Pactual, maior banco de investimento da américa latina. Nosso propósito é transformar ativos desvalorizados no mercado de crédito e real estate. Atuamos na gestão de créditos inadimplentes corporativos, ajudando fundos, investidores, instituições financeiras e empresas a encontrarem soluções estratégicas para seus negócios. Isso é possível, devido às nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Principais destaques

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

  • Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
  • Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
  • Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask) e frontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando em kubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Python (Flask ou FastAPI), garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura técnica e para o desenho de soluções que traduzam demandas de negócio em sistemas robustos e eficientes;
  • Implantar integrações e automações utilizando o ecossistema AWS (EventBridge, SQS, RDS, Lambda, S3, entre outros);
  • Atuar na observabilidade e sustentação de aplicações em ambiente Kubernetes, com foco em confiabilidade e resiliência;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, dados e negócios) para evoluir continuamente a plataforma tecnológica da Enforce;
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estratégicas de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos

  • +8 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, utilizamos Python e frameworks modernos (Flask, FastAPI ou similares) mas caso você venha do Java e tenha desejo de trabalhar com nossa stack não será problema;
  • Vivência em ambientes baseados em microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (preferencialmente EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, RDS e S3);
  • Conhecimentos em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alta qualidade;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com iniciativa e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em sistemas financeiros, gestão de crédito ou recuperação de ativos;
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de dados e automação de processos complexos;
  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.
  • Plano Médico e Odontológico Bradesco;
  • Cartão Flash (VA/VR e auxílio flexível);
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados anual;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass );
  • Programa de Capacitação (Auxílio educação);

Aqui, o aprendizado é constante: a cada novo ativo adquirido, você estará imerso em um processo dinâmico de identificação de problemas e criação de estratégias eficazes. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de transformar mercados, impulsionar grandes projetos e crescer profissionalmente em um ambiente enérgico e colaborativo.

Somos apaixonados por pensar fora da caixa para encontrar soluções inovadoras e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem do mesmo entusiasmo por fazer a diferença. #VemSerEnforce.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Position Summary

Reporting to our Product Data Management Team Leader, you will be responsible for Product Data Management (PDM) process design of specifications for data management tools and IT development projects, project management, data quality management and continuous improvement of SAP material master data to support Rockwell Automation global business processes. Work with other team members and departments supported by the PDM team.

Your Responsibilities

  • Enterprise data management of SAP product/material master data

The essentials – You Will Have

  • Can manage projects.
  • Project skills.

  • Frequently work with peers and customers to gain cooperation of others or conduct presentations of technical information/project activities.

Business

    • Idea to Offering

    • Market to Quote
    • Order to Cash
    • Engineer to Order
    • Issue to Resolution
    • Configure to Order
    • Demand to Renew
    • Understand the relationships and dependencies between master data creation and consuming processes.
    • Can identify and address gaps and inefficiencies in processes and data requirements.

Education and Experience

  • Five years minimum experience working with ERP master data
  • Four‑year degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain Management, or a related field

The Preferred – You might Also Have

  • SAP ECC or similar ERP systems

  • Experience with JavaScript, Python, CSS, PowerShell, and User Interface design

What we offer

  • Personal hours.

Profissional responsável por adquirir materiais recicláveis, negociando com fornecedores, empresas de coleta seletiva e outros parceiros, com o objetivo de garantir a oferta contínua de matéria-prima para empresas que atuam no setor de reciclagem.

Pesquisa de fornecedores: Identificar, avaliar e selecionar fornecedores de materiais recicláveis, como papel, plástico, metais, entre outros.

Negociação: Negociar preços, prazos e condições de compra dos materiais recicláveis, buscando sempre as melhores condições de custo-benefício.

Gestão de estoque: Monitorar e controlar o stoque de materiais recicláveis para garantir o abastecimento contínuo da produção.

Controle de qualidade: Avaliar a qualidade dos materiais adquiridos, garantindo que atendam às especificações e normas da empresa.

Documentação: Gerenciar toda a documentação relativa à compra de materiais, como notas fiscais, contratos e autorizações.

Parcerias: Estabelecer e manter boas relações com fornecedores e parceiros do setor de reciclagem, a fim de criar redes de fornecimento estáveis e sustentáveis.

Análise de mercado: Acompanhar tendências e variações de preço no mercado de recicláveis para realizar compras estratégicas.

Sustentabilidade: Garantir que as práticas de compra estejam alinhadas com os princípios de sustentabilidade e responsabilidade ambiental.

title: Senior Product Designer - Performance & Ongoing Operations
description:
Senior Product Designer - Performance & Ongoing Operations

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you\'ll do:

  • Collaborate & Influence: Partner with engineering, product management, and commercial teams to define and execute a shared vision for our digital experience.
  • Lead UX Strategy: Own your squad’s product design roadmap , shaping customer journey maps, user flows, and service blueprints to guide impactful solutions.
  • Design & Deliver: Drive end-to-end design execution—from early discovery and prototyping to shipping products and iterating based on feedback.
  • Facilitate & Align: Lead workshops, discovery sessions, and critiques to bring stakeholders into the design process, aligning on challenges and opportunities.
  • Advocate for the User: Champion user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, balancing business goals with a great customer experience.

What you\'ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Graphic Design, Digital Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or Industrial Design.
  • Strong communicator & storyteller – You can articulate design decisions clearly, influence stakeholders, and present ideas effectively in English.
  • Proven experience shipping digital products – You’ve worked in cross-functional teams, using iterative processes with both qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • Systems thinker with a tactical mindset – You can zoom out to see the bigger picture but also execute with precision at a detailed level.
  • Experience with UX research & strategy – You proactively uncover problems worth solving and ensure the team stays focused on the right challenges.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects without missing a beat – You’re adaptable and can shift focus while maintaining high-quality work.
  • Have experience working with Design Systems.
  • Strong English required for this position.

Nice To Have:

  • Experience working with back o ffice tools
  • Experience with Data Visualization design

Please Be Prepared to:

  • Include your updated portfolio either as an attachment or as a link to an online version within your resume.
  • Prepare a presentation of a product design case and prototype to be shared during the interviews.

Join our dynamic SAP support team as a SAP Senior Specialist PP/QM for S4 Hana, where you will play a key role in optimizing and maintaining our SAP landscape. As a seasoned professional, you'll leverage your expertise to ensure the smooth functioning of SAP systems, troubleshoot issues, resolving tickets promptly, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Provide expert guidance in SAP solutions, focusing on support and maintenance;

  • Take charge of implementing preventive measures within the SAP support processes to enhance stability and optimize business operations.

  • Minimum 8+years of relevant experience in a comparable role within SAP (ECC6 / S4 Hana) with hands-on application management;

  • Strong candidates will have knowledge and experience with three or more of the following SAP areas: materials management, procurement, inventory warehouse management, sales operations, logistics, finance and controlling;
  • Strong continuous improvement, problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex SAP issues;
  • Integration experience integrating SAP with different business systems, especially MES systems, as well as with working with integration tools;
  • Experience in a discrete manufacturing and/or automotive environment is preferred.

Skills

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams;
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing business processes related to the business application(s) concerned;
  • Understanding of technical environment of the business application(s) concerned;
  • Advanced English (verbal and written);
  • Knowledge of basic project management and change management procedures within IT.

Qualifications

  • IT /Business Degree or Equivalent;
  • SAP & ITIL Certification is preferred.

title: Senior Product Designer – Shopping Journey
description:
Senior Product Designer – Shopping Journey

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer (Senior) to join our Shopping Journey team. You’ll be responsible for designing user-centered experiences that drive real impact across the shopping experience, from discovery to post-sales. If you enjoy thinking strategically, creating scalable solutions, and collaborating with other designers to deliver simple, efficient, and inclusive experiences, this role is for you. You’ll work closely with experienced designers in an agile environment, with room to propose, test, and deliver solutions at scale.

What you'll do:

  • Lead end-to-end design processes, from discovery through delivery.
  • Map and design journeys within the shopping ecosystem, focusing on usability, clarity, and conversion.
  • Create flows, prototypes, and interfaces based on data, research, and usability best practices, drawing from sources like Baymard Institute and Nielsen Norman Group.
  • Participate and lead discovery workshops and co-creation dynamics to map opportunities and prioritize solutions.
  • Support definition of success metrics and hypothesis validation.
  • Collaborate with UX Writing, UX Research, Product, and Engineering to ensure cohesive solutions.
  • Defend design decisions using strong rationale grounded in user needs and business impact.
  • Contribute to and evolve the design system with scalable, consistent, and accessible components.
  • Take part in design rituals like critiques, reviews, and feedback sessions.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Graphic Design, Digital Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or Industrial Design.
  • Hands-on experience as a Product Designer delivering end-to-end digital products (web and/or mobile).
  • Solid understanding of UX, UI, prototyping, and usability best practices.
  • Proficiency with Figma and familiarity with tools like Lucidchart, Maze, or similar.
  • Ability to clearly articulate and defend design decisions using data, benchmarks, and empathy for diverse audiences.
  • Experience working in agile environments, collaborating with Product, Engineering, and other Designers.
  • Advanced English for documentation and occasional global collaboration.
  • Experience in B2B, marketplace, e-commerce, or large-scale platforms.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with discovery frameworks, product metrics, and A/B testing.
  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design principles.

More about you:

  • A curious mindset and investigative approach to deeply understand problems before solving them.
  • Clear and effective communication across different formats and audiences.
  • Proactive attitude to suggest improvements, test ideas, and learn from outcomes.
  • Genuine collaboration with active listening and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Attention to visual consistency and detail, with ownership of the impact delivered.
  • Interest in growing within a team that values excellence, autonomy, and continuous learning.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

title: Analista de QA III
description:
Analista de Qualidade III

O Analista de Qualidade de Software (QA) Senior tem a responsabilidade de garantir a qualidade dos produtos e dos processos de software desenvolvidos e implementados pela empresa, através de testes, documentações, boa comunicação, implantação e melhorias de processos.

Executa suas atividades com autonomia, responsabilidade e foco na entrega. Demonstra domínio do processo, atuando de forma fluida e com naturalidade. Além disso, é capaz de acompanhar e apoiar o trabalho de outros QAs e do time de desenvolvimento sempre que necessário.

Atua como elo de ligação entre Líder de Equipe, PO, Desenvolvedores e demais membros do time de desenvolvimento, com foco em qualidade e entrega de valor para o usuário final. Além de ensinar e mentorar outros QAs sobre as boas práticas de Qualidade de Software.

Auxilia na análise e refinamento de solicitações dos clientes internos e externos para ajudar na comprovação dos problemas, na identificação das reais necessidades dos usuários e na descrição das solicitações de melhoria. Contribuindo para a definição dos pontos que serão validados em diversas etapas do processo de desenvolvimento, entre elas, a etapa de Testes.

Auxilia na disseminação da cultura Lean, disseminando o pilar de Qualidade entre todos os integrantes do time e em todas as etapas do processo de desenvolvimento do time em que estiver inserido.

Defende a cultura de Qualidade e contribui para que todos os integrantes do time se sintam responsáveis pela qualidade em todas as etapas do processo de desenvolvimento, de acordo com suas atribuições.

Contribui com novas ideias e melhorias que visam melhorar a qualidade dos processos realizados pelo time.

Responsabilidades

Identificar em cada demanda de desenvolvimento quais tipos e técnicas de testes são apropriados para serem aplicados, para assegurar que os sistemas desenvolvidos pela empresa possuem uma boa cobertura de testes e que as entregas estejam adequadas.

  • Validar regras de negócio dos sistemas, comprovar a correção de bugs, identificar possíveis riscos e inconsistências nos sistemas visando a prevenção de problemas futuros.
  • Ter boa capacidade de leitura e interpretação de texto para compreender cada demanda de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de forma ativa de reuniões de planejamento e refinamento, além dos eventos do Scrum, contribuindo com a visão de Qualidade sobre os assuntos que estiverem sendo discutidos.

Analisar e identificar quando uma nova demanda realmente faz sentido para o produto ou quando ela talvez precise ser revista, por quaisquer motivos que sejam, desde uma história vagamente escrita, um fluxo incompleto, dentre outros.

  • Descrever problemas encontrados durante os testes de forma simples, objetiva, isenta, sem julgamentos e sem dupla interpretação.
  • Reportar bugs e melhorias de forma eficiente, onde esteja claro para o desenvolvedor e todo o time qual o problema e a melhor maneira de reproduzi-lo.
  • Comunicar todas as pessoas vinculadas ao processo de desenvolvimento, desde o Cliente (interno ou externo), passando pelo Gestor, PO, Analistas, Desenvolvedores, Designers, outros QAs e qualquer outra pessoa/função que esteja relacionada com o processo, desde a sua concepção até o seu suporte pós entrega.
  • Realizar pair programming junto aos desenvolvedores para aplicar a cultura de qualidade em testes unitários, processos e melhorias, além de prevenir práticas que possam prejudicar a qualidade dos sistemas e processos.
  • Analisar os resultados de cada entrega e reconhecer padrões de problemas/dificuldades que o time apresenta no desenvolvimento do sistema para que possam ser melhorados ao longo do tempo.
  • Analisar o processo de desenvolvimento em que está inserido e conseguir entender eventuais falhas que possam prejudicar a entrega do produto, prevenindo assim, novos problemas futuros.
  • Participar de entrevistas técnicas para a contratação de novos QAs.
  • Aprender novas tecnologias e aplicar novos processos de testes quando for necessário e quando se aplicar ao contexto de trabalho em que estiver inserido.

Competências Técnicas

  • Graduação completa em Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Processos Ágeis (cultura Lean, Scrum/Kanban), Tipos de Teste (caixa branca, caixa preta, regressão), Técnicas de Teste (valor limite, tabela de decisão, transição de estado), Gitflow, CI/CD.
  • Lógica de Programação e T‑SQL básicos.

NetCracker Technology is seeking a Senior OSS Business Analyst with strong expertise in the OSS, particularly in Resource Inventory and Service Orchestration for different Telecom domains – IP/MPLS, DWDM, MW for B2B and B2C services as well as the Data Migration aspect of those.   • Identify, collect, clarify, and organize functional requirements for new solution features and change requests

  • Design solution components, including object models, flows, user interfaces, and integration interfaces

  • Participate in the development of new modules and components
  • Prepare data mapping and data validation documentation within the scope of ETL processes

Required Experience

  • Experience in software product development and implementation (telecommunications domain preferred)

  • Solid knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases
  • Understanding of OSS/BSS frameworks and telecom standards: TMF, ETSI, ITU, 3GPP, IETF, MEF, ONAP
  • Understanding of network management protocols and languages: YANG, REST, gRPC, gNMI, NETCONF, SNMP, CLI
  • Good knowledge of SQL
  • Experience using JSON for data exchange is a plus
  • Understanding of REST services is a plus
  • Understanding of software development lifecycles (RUP, Agile, etc)
  • Good technical English writing and communication skills
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in senior network engineering or analytical roles
  • Availability to work from the office on a Hybrid mode from either our São Paulo or Campinas offices

Education

description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as a liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate the completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP-based interfaces using IBM and third-party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.

    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems

title: Experienced UVM Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview

As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you’ll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex’s embedded software stack. That means hands‑on, low‑level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low‑level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You’ll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/ OP-TEE , and hardware‑backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production‑ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure‑by‑default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware‑in‑the‑loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands‑on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self‑development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature‑rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self‑driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. description:
Join to apply for the Técnico (a) em Radiologia / Clinica Imagem Vera Cruz role at Hospital Vera Cruz

Sobre o Hospital

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI. Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care. A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos. Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar exames de radiologia convencional, tomografia computadorizada, ressonância magnética e outros procedimentos de imagem conforme protocolos estabelecidos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica dos exames, a segurança do paciente e o cumprimento das normas de radioproteção;
  • Atuar junto com equipe multiprofissional;
  • Preparar e posicionar pacientes para a realização dos exames;
  • Operar equipamentos de imagem digital e sistemas PACS/RIS;
  • Cumprir normas de segurança e radioproteção, zelando pelo uso adequado dos EPIs e EPCs de radiologia (avental plumbífero, protetores etc.);
  • Manter organização e conservação dos equipamentos e salas de exame;
  • Prestar atendimento humanizado aos pacientes e acompanhantes.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Técnica em Radiologia completa;
  • Registro ativo no CRTR;
  • Conhecimentos em equipamentos digitais (CR/DR), tomografia computadorizada, ressonância magnética e sistemas de informática na saúde;
  • Desejável experiência prévia em hospital/clínica de diagnóstico por imagem;
  • Desejável familiaridade e/ou experiência com Ressonância Magnética;
  • Disponibilidade total de horário.

title: Customer Service Lead - Campinas/SP
description:
Customer Service Lead - Campinas/SP

Position: Customer Service Lead

Work Location: Campinas/SP

Work Model: Hybrid

Position Summary
The Customer Service Lead serves as the point person for managing complex customer problems and is the first line of support in coordinating a group of customer service representatives. The ultimate goal in this role is to provide exceptional service and support throughout the order to cash process while serving as a resource expert to the customer service team. As this role supports both internal and external customers it requires a fine balance of meeting customer needs and expectations along with company policy and procedures. Our Customer Service Leads represent the voice of the company and also serve as a platform to educate our customers and promote the company by creating opportunities to educate, adding value by identifying opportunities and serving as a concierge of resources. In addition to being customer‑facing, this role works with various stakeholders including Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, R&D, and Marketing to create an overarching approach to best‑in‑class customer service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identifies and solves problems that may be brought forward by other departments, and is consulted by Customer Service Representatives when problems arise with little or no precedent;
  • Acts as a team leader coordinating the work of others but is not a formal Supervisor; supports in balancing the team workload;
  • Contact point with the Supervisor for escalations and/or for cascading information to the team;
  • Capable of leading and managing a small project;
  • Conducts peer quality and order accuracy audits; provides clear and succinct feedback to the Supervisor for review during scheduled coaching with team members;
  • Creates open communication with customers and field sales & service so that any changes or impact on customer expectations are timely communicated (i.e. timing of service and delivery, receipt of orders, reporting);
  • Answers incoming calls and emails that deal with Customers’ needs and expectations, identifies and captures value‑added activities, provides recommendations to resolve concerns & queries, educates Customers on company‑related procedures (i.e. Customer Programs, Logistics Discounts, Order Handling, Product Lead‑times, Returns, Credits);
  • As customer issues arrive, takes ownership of concern(s) and resolves within Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and when necessary, coordinates activities with other departments to ensure complete customer satisfaction;
  • Actively participates in managing the month‑end processes (i.e. participating in month‑end meetings, reporting on order management efforts, coordination of customer appointments, identifying risks to meeting target);
  • Effectively and efficiently addresses customers’ special needs and requirements, including resolution of complaints and issues; completes new customer surveys regarding the satisfaction of installations, order handling, and product capabilities; manages all follow‑up related activities derived as an outcome of feedback received during the completion of surveys;
  • Active participant in on‑going training to develop expertise;
  • Approaches customer concerns with an owner mindset to identify the root cause and communicates with key stakeholders to avoid similar concerns;
  • Proactively develops and manages professional relationships with Customer contacts and the internal organization to develop a network of resources;
  • Resolves Customer feedback issues and involves the appropriate individuals or groups in the resolution of issues that are beyond the scope of the CSRs and ensures closure;
  • Communicates frequently with management to provide updates of team progress, account specific developments, and escalation of issues or concerns;
  • Makes recommendations and implements improvements to existing processes;
  • Actively participates in cross‑functional meetings to identify ways we can improve the service we offer to internal and external customers.

Required Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent; Associate and/or Bachelor’s degree preferred;
  • 5 years of relevant work experience in a Customer‑facing role preferred;
  • Knowledge of the existing Customer base, company policies and procedures;
  • Advanced computer literacy (SAP, CRM Tool‑CRM OD, Salesforce, Microsoft Office, Gmail and Google docs);
  • Ability to work and report to work on time and perform full shift (as there is a requirement to cover different time zones);
  • High speed internet access for occasional work from home capabilities.

Additional Qualifications

  • Ability to apply knowledge of the business and marketplace to advance the organization’s goals;
  • Professional communication skills – should be able to communicate with customers, internal stakeholders, peers, and vendors both verbally and via e‑mail in a respectful and friendly manner when under stress;
  • Active listening skills – ability to ask probing questions, understand concerns and overcome objectives;
  • Ability to build relationships by phone and e‑mail;
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced environment – should be able to multi‑task with proven follow‑through and adherence to changing priorities and deadlines;
  • Attention to detail – should be able to complete accurate data entry tasks;
  • Action orientated – should be able self‑start and follow up on feedback to ensure positive outcomes with a willingness to learn;
  • Collaborative team player – should be able to establish solid working relationships with stakeholders with a friendly disposition and high energy;
  • Desire to challenge current processes for improvement;
  • Comfortable with presenting information and training in a group setting;
  • Candidates should have experience in working in a large, fast‑paced, time‑sensitive office environment;
  • Strong analytical skills, technically apt, adept at problem solving and managing escalations;
  • Ability to multi‑task, prioritize and comfortable with rapid change;
  • Detail‑oriented, self‑motivated; ability to take on additional responsibilities as required and be able to work with minimal supervision.

About Solenis

We are a chemical company committed every day to solving complex challenges in water treatment, process improvement, and hygiene for customers in the consumer, industrial, institutional, food and beverage, and pool and spa water markets—through people, expertise, and technology. We are a global leader in the production and application of specialty chemicals, focused on delivering sustainable solutions for water‑intensive industries, including consumer, industrial, institutional, food and beverage, and pool and spa water markets. Our mission is to be a trusted partner and deliver value by solving operational and sustainability challenges with the right people, the right expertise, and the right technology—providing solutions that help preserve natural resources and promote cleaner, safer environments.

At Solenis, you will find an excellent work environment with autonomy, challenges, and growth opportunities. We value diversity and are on a continuous journey to become a more diverse and inclusive company every day, which is reflected in our recruitment processes.

We emphasize that everyone is welcome, regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic. The selected candidate must demonstrate exemplary work ethics and high standards of integrity.

Overview


Join to apply for the Principal Product Manager role at AB InBev .


AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.


About AB InBev Growth Group


Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world


.In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.


We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.


About the Role


We’re seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Principal Product Manager to shape the future of our sales systems and tools. In this highly autonomous, individual contributor role, you’ll lead initiatives that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of our frontline sales teams including field, administrative, and tele-sales functions.


You’ll take a step back to uncover foundational opportunities that drive long-term impact across the business. Your work will help unify sales workflows, elevate user experience, and influence how we scale and support sales organizations.


What You’ll Do



  • Develop deep expertise in how frontline sales teams operate by identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs through research and partnership.

  • Create and champion a strategic product vision that aligns user workflows, business goals, and emerging trends in sales operations.

  • Define mid- to long-term initiatives that improve productivity, scalability, and system usability.

  • Collaborate with partners in product, engineering, design, data, and sales operations to frame high-impact problems and explore solutions. Connect business strategy, user needs, and technical capabilities to influence product direction and priorities.

  • Advocate for changes across process, technology, and organizational practices that deliver meaningful impact.

  • Clearly articulate trade-offs and opportunities to senior stakeholders and help guide resource allocation across teams.


What We’re Looking For



  • Proven success leading strategic product initiatives in complex environments, ideally at the principal level or equivalent.

  • Ability to think holistically and long-term, with a focus on solving systemic issues over incremental improvements.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful insights, and use metrics to drive strategic decision.

  • Experience working in or closely with field sales, tele-sales, or sales operations organizations

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders at all levels.

  • Strong product intuition, user empathy, and a systems-thinking mindset.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and thriving in a role with high autonomy and broad scope


Preferred Qualifications



  • Background in B2B sales systems, CRM platforms, or internal tools supporting sales teams.

  • Experience leading discovery and research in enterprise or cross-functional environments

  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, with the ability to collaborate closely with designers to deliver intuitive and effective sales tools.

  • Ability to evaluate technical solutions in collaboration with engineering teams and make informed decisions that balance user needs, scalability, and complexity.

  • Advanced degree in business, operations, or a related field is a plus—especially if it supports strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and organizational change. Equivalent experience is equally valued.


More about you



  • You´re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality.

  • You´re motivated by building world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world.

  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;

  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;

  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;

A Fundação FEAC é uma organização da sociedade civil, com sede em Campinas/SP, que há mais de seis décadas atua na promoção da equidade e do desenvolvimento social sustentável.

O Gerente de Dados, Inteligência e Gestão do Conhecimento será responsável por liderar e executar a estratégia de dados, inteligência e gestão do conhecimento da organização. O profissional deverá assegurar que a coleta, o armazenamento, a análise, a sistematização e a disseminação das informações e aprendizados estejam alinhadas à missão social. Sua atuação terá foco tanto no monitoramento contínuo e avaliação de impacto dos projetos sociais, quanto na transformação desse acervo em conhecimento estratégico, que fortaleça a tomada de decisão da própria instituição, de seus parceiros e do ecossistema do terceiro setor.

Além de gerar dados e evidências sobre o impacto das atividades internas, deverá promover e compartilhar conhecimento com públicos internos e externos, por meio de repositórios digitais, publicações, seminários, comunidades de prática e articulações institucionais. O objetivo é consolidar a organização como referência em produção e difusão de inteligência aplicada ao impacto social.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E REQUISITOS

Estratégia e Governança de Dados

  • Definir e implementar a política de dados da organização, incluindo governança, segurança, privacidade (em conformidade com a LGPD) e qualidade.
  • Promover uma cultura orientada a dados, estimulando o uso estratégico de informações para aprimorar a atuação social.
  • Garantir que os processos de coleta, tratamento e análise estejam integrados ao ciclo de decisão institucional.

Gestão Estratégica do Observatório

  • Definir a agenda de pesquisa e os temas prioritários de análise de dados, alinhados à missão e às necessidades do ecossistema social.
  • Desenvolver a visão estratégica do observatório como hub de conhecimento, advocacy e capacitação para o terceiro setor.
  • Garantir a transparência, a acessibilidade e a credibilidade das análises e publicações.

Monitoramento e Avaliação (MA) de Projetos
